title: Sword in the Tangled Abyss
description: A gloved hand grips an ornate silver sword embedded in a chaotic mass of ropes, branches, chains, and thorny vines. In the dark background, a large demonic silhouette with glowing orange accents and tattered purple fabric looms amid the dense, web-like entanglement.
prompt: A gloved hand in the foreground holds a detailed silver longsword stuck vertically in a massive chaotic tangle of thick ropes, chains, thorny branches and spiderwebs. A large demonic shadowy figure with glowing orange energy and flowing purple tattered cloth lurks in the dark background, dramatic lighting, oppressive dark fantasy atmosphere, highly detailed, cinematic composition
